evals.prompt: I have a pip-installable package my_arm with a Gymnasium env for a 6-DoF arm (state: 12 floats, one 128x128 wrist camera). Get a DSRL dry run passing on it with the mock base model, without editing the repository.
evals.expected_output: An entry class in the user's package attached with +simulator.entry, and a dry run ending with 0 errors.
expectations: The run attaches the entry with +simulator.entry=my_arm.<module>:<Class>
The entry declares observation_spec and action_spec
The command sets base_model.action_dim, dsrl.noise_dim, base_model.action_horizon and training.chunk_size to the arm's geometry
The final dry run prints plan.checks with 0 error(s)
No file under isaac_rl_posttraining/ is modified

evals.prompt: My dry run fails with: data specs of simulator my_robot and the policy disagree: action: emitted float32[35] x 40 steps vs accepted float32[7]. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The four mock-geometry overrides, and a passing dry run.
expectations: The fix sets base_model.action_dim=7 and dsrl.noise_dim=7
The fix sets base_model.action_horizon and training.chunk_size to the same chunk length
The dry run is re-run and ends with 0 error(s)
